about_the_game:
Mine until your arms drop off!

In Prison Miner you will rank up through various ranks discovering new mines and materials along the way to be able to upgrade your equipment and mine even faster. Until eventually, you do it all again! But, this time you will have all your previous equipment and be able to discover even more new areas, ores, equipment and upgrades

Explore 30+ Unique Mines

Prison Miner has over 30 unique mines, each with their own resources and items to explore as you rank up

Your Tools Grow With You

In Prison Miner getting your tools won't be the end of your journey to greatness, you can level them up as you use them to achieve even greater heights with them!

Prestige

After ranking up through all the mines you get to do it all over again! But worry not, you will not lose any of the items acquired on your journey and you will still have access to all previously visited areas. You will have to rank up through all the ranks again but you will also get to visit new areas after that and upgrade your stats even further through the prestige skill tree!

Mine Rewards

Sometimes you only really want the valuables from mining, but we offer rewards for fully clearing a mine allowing you to gain and upgrade gemstones to further your abilities even more!
